BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.title: Menitas
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.firstVisitEver.0-: Who wishes to gaze upon my glorious work?
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Ah, a mortal. Tell me what you desire.
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: You again. Perhaps it's time one of these glorious creations saw usage in the battlefield anyways
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.anci: Red one! Let me upgrade your armor.
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.anc: Many a creature's blood rests upon you. Why do you destroy them so, when their remains are so useful?
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.anci: If you see that Tanx, tell him to stop by, red one. We have sparring to do!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancien: I sense the blood of a hunter in you, green one. Bring me some of your spoils, and I shall reward you greatly.
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.SILENT.1-0r.ancie: Ready to wear the skin of your enemies? What have you brought for me this time?
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancien: I have been too preoccupied with my work as of late, green one. We must go out on a hunt sometime!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancien: Multitudes of constructs have fell to my blades, but I sense spirit in you, blue one. What is your desire?
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.DEFECT.0-2.ancien: The Architect can be cruel. He does not understand the beauty of what he creates. Take this!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.DEFECT.1-0r.ancie: Another journey upwards. I've prepared some of my finest for you, my blue friend!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancien: Blue friend! You spend so much on your own repairs, let me teach you to create something new!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.DEFECT.2-1.ancien: [i][font_size=22]Menitas teaches Defect the art of the forge.[/font_size][/i]
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.REGENT.0-0.ancien: A stunning sword from the stars! Mind if I take a look, orange one?
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.REGENT.0-1.char: Only if you give me one of your wares in return, and give it the honor of being weilded by me!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.REGENT.1-0r.ancie: Orange one! One day, you must lend me your blade to study.
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.REGENT.2-0.ancien: Back to obliterate your enemies, orange one? Take what you wish!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.NECROBINDER.0-0.a: Hello, pink one. A worthy scythe, but would you like a weapon perfected?
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.NECROBINDER.0-1.n: Anything that shall help me slay my enemies will be appreciated!
Pink one. I have been studying your magic. It shall make my forge ever the more glorious!
BAGELSMOD-MENITAS.talk.NECROBINDER.2-0.a: Perhaps your righteous anger will teach the Architect to respect his creations! Have this!
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.title: Karyei
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0: It is good to see your face for the last time.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Life spends itself trying to find order, but there is only Us.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: We were here before Everything, and We will be here after.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.ancie: We see you bound by chains. We will not fix it, but we will change you, as all things must.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.anci: The anger in you... it is beautiful, uncontrolled.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.ancie: The world reviles Us, but it needs Us. So we act.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancient: Your sisters once tried hunting Us. We let them have a piece, as a mercy.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.SILENT.1-0r.ancien: Why do you prize the trophy, rather than the hunt?
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancient: Lovely wretch, keep bringing Us that poison. Its potency is sanguine.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancient: A mortal rebuilding itself. Effortlessly admirable.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.DEFECT.1-0r.ancien: Oh, what We would give to take a look in your Mind. Ah, well. In due Time...
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancient: Your orbs... concentrated power. Have you thought what would happen if you were to unleash their full potential?
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.REGENT.0-0.ancient: You try to assert control you do not have. It is pathetic.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.REGENT.0-1.char: [i][font_size=22]The Regent tries to retort, but finds he cannot speak.[/font_size][/i]
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.REGENT.1-0r.ancien: Silence is the only teacher for those who talk to drown their dissolution to entropy.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.REGENT.2-0.ancient: Everybody deserves the boons of chaos, but you the least of all. Be glad you get anything.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.REGENT.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]The Regent tries to scream, but has no mouth.[/font_size][/i]
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.NECROBINDER.0-0.an: A curious duo. Would you like to know how it all ends?
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.NECROBINDER.0-1.ch: I know how it ends, with a death worthy of the history books.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.NECROBINDER.0-2.an: That is the only thing any tale can be certain of.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.NECROBINDER.1-0r.a: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust. But you knew that already.
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.NECROBINDER.2-0.an: Do you know what curses your doom calls upon?
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.NECROBINDER.2-1.ch: The black magic I call upon is not yours to question!
BAGELSMOD-KARYEI.talk.NECROBINDER.2-2.an: Only one who does not know where it leads would answer that way.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.title: Phthalo
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.firstVisitEver.0-: Sugar, you look tired. Care for tea?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Growth requires pain, but through blossoming there is beauty.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: I have seen death more times than I can count, yet I create anyway. Take what you wish.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.ANY.2-0r.ancient: I know what you are, puppet of Neow, but I do not blame you. She repurposes my beauty because she wants what I have.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.anci: Creature of Flesh and Blood, why do you hate others so when they are the same as you?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.anc: It seems hubris to wrap yourself in steel when nature provides the greatest armor.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.anci: Extinction always brings me sorrow... the Valleyguards you slaughtered, I knew them well.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancien: Creature of Blight and Breath, it pains me to see a being stuck constantly between life and death.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.SILENT.1-0r.ancie: I admire a hunter such as you, but it is curious that you do not use your prizes to sustain yourself
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancien: I must apologize for your condition, Creature of Blight and Breath. It was my teas on which your disease was based.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancien: Creature of Steel and Wire, you are not one of mine, but yet you have the same spark in your soul.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.DEFECT.1-0r.ancie: I have been trying to carve a creature like you, yet I can not seem to replicate your sentience. Tea?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancien: You seem to take a liking to my tea. How is this, when you cannot drink like we can?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.REGENT.0-0.ancien: You are unlike anything I have yet seen. Your life... it has a permanence to it. Tea?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.REGENT.0-0.char: It is wonderful to be with one who honors the refined arts, but I must go forth and regale the world with my superiority!
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.REGENT.1-0r.ancie: Fellow lifegiver. I respect your craft, but be warned, creation does not grant you dominance.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.REGENT.2-0.ancien: You are strange, Creature of Star and Sky... only a faint trace of Neow on you.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.REGENT.2-1.char: The Whale? A hack! She only gives me tools to help me fulfill my glorious purpose.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.REGENT.2-2.ancien: You are still alive, Creature of Star and Sky- and where there is life, there will be an end.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.NECROBINDER.0-0.a: Creature of Bone and Brittle, your lifeforce remains strong, despite lacking a body. Care for tea?
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.NECROBINDER.1-0.c: There is no time for tea! Only vengeance!
I have felt endless pain from death. While mine faded with time, yours burns brightly.
Perhaps it's what keeps you tethered to this plane.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.NECROBINDER.2-0.a: Your companion, Creature of Bone and Brittle. I knew the creature from whence it came.
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.NECROBINDER.2-1.a: The architect shall right his wrong, or suffer the same fate he cast upon Osty's holder
BAGELSMOD-PHTHALO.talk.NECROBINDER.2-2.a: Those who are resurrected are never who you expect. Life was meant to end.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.title: Mnemi
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: [i][font_size=22]just close your eyes, soon you'll be home...[/font_size][/i]
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.IRONCLAD.0-0.ancien: last bastion. do you have loved ones?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.IRONCLAD.1-0r.ancie: your pain makes me proud. it reminds me that i am alive.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.IRONCLAD.2-0.ancien: last bastion, your memories remain spotty. what did that neow do to you?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.SILENT.0-0.ancient: forgotten sister. what do you cherish most?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.SILENT.1-0r.ancient: memories are wonderful trophies, but to give them away is the most wonderful trophy of all
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.SILENT.2-0.ancient: the blight in you... it plagues your mind. we are both ghosts still cursed to walk, forgotten sister.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.DEFECT.0-0.ancient: remaining half. you have memories from artifice, how curious...
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.DEFECT.1-0r.ancient: you have a past worth pursuing, but no amount of fixing will bring it back.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.DEFECT.2-0.ancient: you are just as alive as every other mortal i've seen walk in here, if not more, remaining half. remember this.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.REGENT.0-0.ancient: spurned king, your mind holds tales of a wonderful distant land. why come here?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.REGENT.0-1.char: The world must know of my royalty! Those ungrateful [sine]Starrians[/sine] do not appreciate my mandate!
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.REGENT.0-2.ancient: if it pleases you, but the most beautiful memories are always the ones made in the place you call home.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.REGENT.1-0r.ancient: your vainglorious search will not give you purpose, but you must go forth. the future is a past waiting to be built.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.REGENT.2-0.char: I have no time to wallow in your melancholy! Show me your trinkets!
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.NECROBINDER.0-0.cha: Your home reminds me of my own...
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.NECROBINDER.1-0.anc: your past will never return, but your dedication to it shall reward you. please, take a piece of my memories
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.NECROBINDER.1-0r.an: to be deprived of a past is the worst fate, vengeful remains. be glad you have a purpose to drive you forth.
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.NECROBINDER.2-0.anc: care to stay a while? bask in the past for a moment longer?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.NECROBINDER.2-1.anc: how does it feel, vengeful remains, to remember what you fight for?
BAGELSMOD-MNEMI.talk.NECROBINDER.2-2.cha: It pains me. I wish to stay here forever, but I cannot. Let me take a souvenir to remember this moment by.
